identity.description: Turns a paper’s method or a research idea into a PyTorch ARCHITECTURE SKELETON: ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW, PYTORCH SKELETON (a model class + forward with the cited methods’ design choices as comments), DATA & PREPROCESSING, TRAINING & EVALUATION, and LIMITATIONS — each citing the corpus papers it draws on. Returns a structured skeleton.json artifact. Skeletons are unverified starting points, not runnable code.

inputs.description: A research question about the brain-technology corpus (citations returned as [n])
inputs.example: What are the best EEG motor-imagery decoding methods?

outputs.description: The agent’s answer, citing corpus papers as [n]
Cited papers as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)
Structured skeleton as JSON: idea, cited papers, and parsed sections (title + body per section)

_default.description: Answer text streamed token-by-token as it is generated
